name: router-kind-p1
description: G1, the router kind (theory-2 6.24): fresh-gate probit trees, limit 4, threshold 1M, split noise 0.03, with an LR cluster router (T-P-Lc-merge) x2 against the NB router (T-P-Nc-merge, seat 1) x2; the router the one factor. Prediction: LR 20-40 below NB unless the fresh gate steadies the LR router. Launched 11-11 08:47 by the coordinator for the user's six-model shortlist (theory-2 6.24). F-P x2 added to the field (a deviation from 6.24's four-line design) so the gain over the same leaf's flat is measured in the same field, as in probit-widen-p1b/p1c. Own games at T 0.1 (T 0.02 training costs 100-200); read cold at T 0.02 at plies 1-2.
